match_stages.stage_briefing:
CM 25-08 We Lost Hero or Zero is a 10 round, 50 point Comstock Classifier course. 
There are 5USPSA targets. The best 2 hits per target will score. 
The start signal is audible.

The Handgun Start Position is standing anywhere inside of the shooting area, wrists below belt.Handgun is loaded and holstered.
The PCC Start Position is standing anywhere inside of the shooting area. Carbine is loaded with stockon belt.
The Make Ready position is at the same location as the Start Position.

Upon the start signal, engage targets from within the shooting area.

CM 25-03 Let Him Cook is a 10 round, 50 point Comstock Classifier course. 
There are 5 USPSAtargets. The best 2 hits per target will score. 
The start signal is audible.

The Handgun Start Position is standing inside of the shooting area, toes touching marks, wrists belowbelt. Handgun is loaded and holstered.
The PCC Start Position is standing inside of the shooting area, toes touching marks. Carbine is loadedwith stock on belt.

The Make Ready position is at the same location as the Start Position.
Upon the start signal, engage targets from within the shooting area.
